abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care.
section:
### Comparison of the arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. This comparison was run at the Oakfield Family Cohort.

Table 6. The measure for each arm, shown subset by subset.

| Subset | Arm | Measure | Count | Total |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Standard care | Blood pressure control | 189 | 450 |
| Older adults, Reduced kidney function, Community clinic | Cardivel | Blood pressure control | 122 | 450 |

These values are listed for every arm and every subset.
